Very disappointing experience with Lucky Tail

I took my dog Milo in for grooming, and after they shaved his tail, he developed a serious skin injury. When I raised my concerns, I was told the issue was already there before grooming, which was surprising since his tail had never been shaved like that before and he was fine after i took him.

His condition got much worse, and I had to take him to the vet. He is now on medication, wearing a cone, and I've spent over $450 in veterinary bills.

What upsets me the most is that nobody warned me about the possible risks of shaving his tail, especially with matting involved, or advised me to prevent him from licking the area after the shaving or to wear a cone after. Had I known, I could have taken precautions before things got this bad.

I understand complications can happen, but proper communication and aftercare instructions are essential. It's heartbreaking to see my dog suffering, and I'm extremely disappointed with this experience. I recommend you take pictures of your dog before or take it to another grooming. I reached out and the didnt take accountability.

always a great experience at Lucky Tail! my dog always drags me to go in (even though he doesn’t like getting groomed)! they are very kind and professional and do a great job. Affordable too for the level of service!! 5 stars

The staff here are also wonderful and extremely responsive to any questions or concerns; often responding quickly to request for updates. Happy to have found Lucky Tail and love their field trip options!

Amazing experience!

Wow, what a great experience! My Shi-chon (Shitzu/Bichon Frisé mix) had her first grooming appt. with Lucky Tail today and we are over the top satisfied with the results. My dog suffers from trauma anxiety from a previous horrible grooming experience so we did our research to find a groomer that specialized in a gentle/holistic approach to grooming. Thankful we found Lucky Tail! They are extremely kind, knowledgeable, and they took amazing care of our girl. They provided video of the session and the level of care and compassion they took when handling her was very clear. What a calm and peaceful environment they provide! The front desk staff were extra kind and thoughtful, gathering as much info as they could to ensure the proper products and techniques were used. They even provided suggestions for some yeast growth they noticed on her paws as well as solutions to keep her skin safe from the sun because we keep her hair very short. They went above and beyond to make sure our dog had the best care. We are so fortunate to have found Lucky Tail and would highly recommend them; especially to owners of dogs that need extra support and a stress-free experience. Thank you to the LT team! We look forward to our next visit!
